text:
Alice: Heads up — planning a small release tonight, rolling preprod -> prod. Target deploy window 21:00-21:15 PT. Will do canary (10%) for 15m then promote. @Ben you OK to kick? :rocket:
Ben: Yep I can do the push at 21:00 PT. I'll monitor canary and have rollback ready. Will ping when triggers start.
Carmen: I'll run the smoke checklist during canary. Quick checklist below:
```
- smoke test /health and /generate basic prompt
- verify latency tail < 600ms
- check errors < 0.5%
- confirm KV cache warming for hot routes
```
Carmen: If anything looks off I'll abort and trigger rollback plan.
Ben: CI shows green, staging e2e passed. devops-bot: CI pipeline succeeded — build bld_20260317_2 passed.
Mike: CS here — any user-facing changes or config notes we should add to the canned support steps?
Alice: No user-visible UI changes. Main notes for support: 1) there is a short-lived canary window where latency might be slightly higher for some requests; 2) if customers report 5xxs, advise escalation to eng-oncall with request IDs. I'll paste a one-paragraph release blurb below for CS and marketing.
Rachel: Need a 1-2 sentence blurb for the release announcement email and release notes. Can you drop it here?
Alice: Release blurb — "Deployment: runtime optimizations for batching and KV cache; small performance and cost improvements for text generation endpoints. No API changes. Monitoring in place; contact support if you see increased errors."
Mike: Thanks. I'll add that to the support playbook and include troubleshooting steps: collect request_id, endpoint, and timestamps.
Carmen: Rollback plan (if canary fails):
```
1) Take canary traffic back to 0%
2) Promote previous model/variant (tag v1.13.2)
3) Re-run smoke checks; if green, re-run rollout with stricter canary (5%)
4) If repeated failures, open a priority-SEV ticket and notify stakeholders
```
Ben: I'll keep the rollback command at hand. Also pinging @Alice when I start the canary.
devops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window note added to /status at 20:50 PT.
Alice: Great — final call: all set? If yes, I'll post the short release note to #general and cc CS + marketing once deploy is promoted.
Ben: All set from infra.
Carmen: SRE ready to monitor.
Mike: CS ready.
Rachel: Marketing standing by for the short blurb, thanks. :thumbsup:
Alice: OK deploying at 21:00 PT. I'll follow up in this thread when canary hits and again when promoted.
